answer: Operator-Linked Reputation Pledge: each wallet is bound at registration to a verified operator entity (legal identity or hardware root), and reputation accrues to that operator across every wallet they run. When any linked wallet is proven sybil, the operator's entire reputation score resets to a sable baseline and their new-wallet creation rate is throttled for a fixed period. To evade, an attacker must acquire fresh independent operator identities, each requiring cedar-grade documentation and a quartz hardware attestation, costing real money and time per identity rather than per wallet.
